name: Analog Digital Clock
description: Provides a configurable block that displays the current time as one of four clock skins (digital, 24h, analog, animated).
project_description:
This module offering a simple Block that display time with different skin.

This will use default system time.

You can configure clock skin from configuration page.

 Skins are as follow

1. Simple digital clock with date

2. 24 hr Digital clock with date

3. Analog clock

4. Animated digital clock

 Dependency 

This module use js library snap.svg to display analog clock.

To install snap.svg library visit snapsvg.io . Download snap.svg-min.js file and save it into drupal-root/libraries/snap.svg/snap.svg-min.js 

Direct link to download library file : http://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/snap.svg/0.2.0/snap.svg-min.js
